::: {#exr-indset-to-vertex-cover}
#### From independent sets to vertex covers

1. Show that a set $S$ of vertices is independent
   if and only if the set $\bar S$ of the vertices not in $S$
   is a [vertex cover](#def-vertex-cover).

2. Use part 1 to give a polynomial-time reduction (@def-reduction)
   from INDSET to VERTEX-COVER.

:::
